integrity: The 1999 foundational bibliographic record was checked for the labyrinth-chaos provenance and exact publication date. The complete twelve-page 2007 same-object article was inspected for the exact equations, route to chaos, multistability, coexisting attractors, long-time standard-deviation statistics, conservative limit, diffusion, and symbolic dynamics. Document-wide searches found no conditional-expectation, variance, or moment theorem matching the accepted statement. A 2024 same-object preprint was compared at abstract and stated-scope level for later bifurcation coverage. The conditional regressions, variance defects, one-Lipschitz speed budget, cyclic directional inequalities, and bounded-memory representation were independently reconstructed, and the algebra was replayed with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is a necessary stationary constraint and does not classify invariant measures or bifurcations.
The cube bound is universal for bounded complete trajectories but is not claimed to be the smallest trapping region.
The correlation formula requires positive receiving-coordinate variance.
The established global-stability threshold at and above critical damping is excluded from the originality claim.
The complete 1999 publisher text was not used for blanket whole-document novelty exclusion.
A differently phrased equivalent fiberwise identity could remain in unindexed literature.
title: Fiberwise feedback calibration and a stationary speed budget in the Thomas cyclic sine flow
